method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories grounded in federation continuity, competition systems and temporally gated development/access evidence.
evidence_rules: Israel ratings use tennis institutions and competition/development evidence only; geopolitical or military conditions are not used as direct sport-rating inputs.
Bulgarian pre-1955 federation and competition history anchors tradition but does not become measured 1955 participation.
Current clubs, programmes and competition calendars are not backcast.
Programme capacity is distinct from participation and player outcomes.
Competition quality is based on organised competition opportunity/system depth rather than one star player's peak.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
